title: Codex reviewer map
description: Maps changed paths to Codex reviewer passes. Read from .github/giskard/codex-reviewer-map.json at the HEAD of the repository's default branch.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference for editor support.

defaults.description: Model and effort defaults. Workflow inputs override these; these override the built-in defaults.

models.description: Alias of defaults, read only when defaults is absent.

references_dir.description: Directory holding role references. Defaults to <agents_dir>/references.

rules.description: Reviewer rules. Each rule selects a reviewer when any changed path matches it. At most 12 reviewers run per pull request.

configDir.description: Relative POSIX path. Segments use [A-Za-z0-9._-] and cannot be '.', '..' or '.git'.

name.description: Reviewer name. The persona is loaded from <agents_dir>/<name>.md or <agents_dir>/<name>.agent.md at the default branch HEAD, then from the bundled persona for security-auditor, infra-reviewer and prompt-critic, then from a generic prompt.

model_kind.description: Selects the normal or critical model and effort defaults.

path_prefixes.description: Matches paths under these prefixes. Combined with path_suffixes, both must match.

path_suffixes.description: Matches paths ending with these suffixes. Combined with path_prefixes, both must match.

path_excludes.description: Path prefixes this rule never matches, even when another matcher does.

role_references.description: Markdown basenames under references_dir staged for this reviewer.
